models.description: Measured here: 100% structurally valid actions, 62% expected action, 189 ms median. The fastest of the three and the one to reach for when a character must answer within a beat. Pairs with the Model_Qwen3.5-2B-Q4_K_M preset.

Measured here: 100% structurally valid actions, 81% expected action, 278 ms median. The best quality per millisecond of the three for reactive characters, and the model behind the recorded sample runs. Pairs with the Model_Granite-4.1-3B-Q4_K_M preset.

Measured here: 100% structurally valid actions, 94% expected action in the Deliberative profile, 574 ms median. The most accurate of the three and the only one measured to clearly benefit from deliberation; suits directors and planners on a slow tick. Pairs with the Model_Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M preset.
